answer: FileLeaseManager in command-center/leases/manager.py stores per-session path leases as lease-<id>.json via tmp-plus-rename. acquire/renew/release are the session lifecycle. note_write always writes destination bytes and never sets refused=true; when the writer is not among active holders of that exact path it appends a lease-conflict event with write_allowed and write_succeeded both true. Expired and released leases drop out of active_holders so they stop generating conflicts. Unleased paths produce an empty conflict list. Overlap (globs, case folding, directory containment) is out of scope (IMP-0411).

blocking_mutant.detail: wrapper that refuses foreign writes fails advisory; live manager does not. Both-states control, not production code.

evidence.detail: Non-holder sess-B wrote 'non-holder-payload' to src/advisory.txt held by sess-A. Event log records lease-conflict with write_allowed=true write_succeeded=true. refused=False.
Implementation files: command-center/leases/manager.py, command-center/schema/file-lease.schema.json, probes under command-center/p2-wave/probes/IMP-0410/.

manager.acquire: declare session_id + paths + ttl; concurrent holders allowed
manager.clock: injectable FakeClock.now so expiry tests do not wall-sleep
manager.note_write: always ok; log lease-conflict per foreign active holder
manager.release: holder-only; status=released; subsequent writes are silent
manager.renew: holder-only; expires_at = now + ttl; refused after expiry

negative_controls.description: write to an unleased path produces zero conflict events
wrapper that refuses foreign writes fails advisory; live manager does not

notes: G-1 for IMP-0410 only. Leases are advisory: they log, they do not block. cloud_ok is not delivery. Did not run unit_manifest.py --write.
question: Implement path leases so a session can declare the files it will write, renew while working, and release on exit. Exact target: a lease must be advisory and never block a write, but every write to a leased path by a non-holder must produce a logged conflict event.

residual_unknowns.claim: Glob/case/directory overlap is IMP-0411; this unit matches exact normalised paths only.

retry.policy: two same-fingerprint structural refutes park BLOCKED with required_fix named; no ADV rebuild circle

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 is a different mechanism from probe 1 (write-refusal and unleased silence vs clocked TTL/renew). Blocking mutant fires on the refused-write state and is silent on the live manager.

advisory.detail: sess-B wrote non-holder-payload to a path leased by sess-A; bytes landed; refused=false; one lease-conflict event

expiry.detail: non-holder write at t+5 logs conflict; write at t+11 (past ttl=10) logs none; neither write is refused

renew_extends.detail: renew at t+8 moves expiry 2010->2018; non-holder at t+13 still conflicts. Unrenewed twin at t+13 is silent.
